article.title: Israel starved Gaza. Now doctors fear it has permanently damaged a generation.
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: In the pediatrics department at Nasser Hospital in Gaza, doctors are seeing a surge in stunted growth among children. This lasting mark of Israel's engineered famine may affect cognition, hormones, and health for generations to come.
